name: Currenthill Military Asset Pack China
summary: High-detail China military ground, air-defence and naval AI units by Currenthill.
description: Part of Currenthill's country asset packs. Extract the complete pack zip into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\tech`; incremental packs go into the existing complete-pack folder. Remove older single-asset versions first. Assets use 4K textures and are heavy to run.
